description: A trait providing methods for handling serialized columns in Drupal, including checking for serialized strings, retrieving serialized property names, and handling custom serialized properties.

methods.name: checkForSerializedStrings
methods.description: Checks if there is a serialized string for a column and throws an exception if invalid data is detected.

methods.name: dataHasStringForSerializeColumn
methods.description: Determines if the data contains a string value for a serialize column.

methods.name: getSerializedPropertyNames
methods.description: Retrieves the property names of serialized columns based on schema or custom definitions.

methods.name: getCustomSerializedPropertyNames
methods.description: Retrieves custom serialized property names defined via plugin or entity settings.
